verdict.rationale: Termius's first-party docs say Workspaces group multiple terminal sessions into one environment and can broadcast the same input to multiple sessions. Snippets can also be executed on multiple hosts at once. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of broadcast input, and documentation of finer controls such as choosing which sessions receive the broadcast.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can group multiple terminal sessions together and broadcast the same command to all of them

citations.quote: Workspaces group multiple terminal sessions into one focused environment... Broadcast the same input to multiple sessions
You can broadcast a command to all sessions simultaneously and save the entire setup as a reusable template.
execute them on multiple hosts at once from the Snippets screen
